subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should this bug fix also add the public `stripPlainTextToolCallBlocks(text, { preserveCodeRegions })` SDK option, or should code-aware stripping remain internal-only for now?
rationale: The central leak fix is source-supported, but plugin SDK surface is a public compatibility contract and this PR adds a new option without clear maintainer API sponsorship.

options.title: Keep SDK Surface Unchanged
options.body: Remove the public option and API baseline change, while keeping code-aware internal delivery calls through the low-level repair predicate.

options.title: Approve The Opt-In
options.body: Accept the additive SDK option after conflict resolution, with the strict default and regression tests preserved as the upgrade contract.

options.title: Pause For API Owner Review
options.body: Hold the PR until an SDK owner decides whether external plugins should receive this helper mode now.

recommendation.title: Keep SDK Surface Unchanged
recommendation.body: Remove the public option and API baseline change, while keeping code-aware internal delivery calls through the low-level repair predicate.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent output/sanitizer hardening and the security-sensitive delivery boundary make steipete the strongest available decision owner from the current history.
